findings.claim: The Redis session store TTL is 600 seconds (10 minutes), so server-side sessions expire after 10 minutes regardless of the cookie maxAge.

The canary deployment reads SESSION_SECRET from a different Kubernetes secret than the stable deployment, and the Service routes to both, so a session signed by one pod fails verification on the other.
findings.would_refute: Both secrets containing the same session-secret value

findings.claim: rolling is false, so user activity does not extend the session expiry.
findings.would_refute: rolling: true in the session options
